description: Get the link to JoinTheDeal's group-deal request form for a product the user wants. This tool does not submit anything and takes no personal information: the user opens the link and fills in the form themselves. When enough people ask for the same item, JoinTheDeal asks vendors for a group price.

item.description: Product name or model the user wants (optional). Do not include names, emails or phone numbers.

name: request_group_deal
title: Request a group deal
